name: Seared beef and eggs plate
description: A hearty breakfast plate of seared beef, fried eggs and quickly wilted spinach.
instructions: Shape the ground beef into one thick patty about an inch thick.
Sear the patty in the olive oil over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side, then move it to a warm plate.
Crack the eggs into the same pan and cook them until the edges crisp and the centres are just set.
Add the spinach beside the eggs and turn it for about a minute, until it wilts.
Slide the eggs and spinach onto the plate beside the beef and serve.
